contents: # Fields encoded before they reach the logs (Monolog) and Sentry events. In a Laba service
# laba/service-bundle sets the groups tokens, credentials and pii: replace one by its name or add your own.
#     payment: { method: filter, fields: [card_number, cvv] }    # sha256 | hmac | filter | prefix, or encoder: <service id>
# Secrets in the path of a URL: a named group is encoded as that field, any other group is [filtered].
# The HTTP request in extra.request of every log record: laba_request.request_context of laba/request-bundle
# (what to add); this bundle encodes it by the groups and paths above.
# Public ids instead of the internal ones of #[PublicId] properties (API Platform, Symfony Serializer, JMS,
# #[MapPublicId]): only in a service that answers outside (front-api). PUBLIC_ID_KEY: bin2hex(random_bytes(16)).
#     paths: ['^/api/']    # every serializer of these requests, not only API Platform's
